text:
ana.engineer: Urgent Q  passport got stolen in Lisbon before my flight home, had to get an emergency travel document and paid an embassy fee + courier to send docs home. Can I expense these?

pete.peopleops: Sorry that happened, Ana. Emergency embassy fees for replacing a passport or getting an emergency travel document are reimbursable when it occurs during business travel. Include receipts and a short incident note.

cfo.finance: Finance process: upload the embassy receipt, courier/tracking receipt, and the card transaction. Category: Travel > Emergency. If you used a personal card, submit as personal reimbursement; if company card, flag it in notes.

ana.engineer: One more nuance  I paid for an express visa to return to a client site (same trip) because my original passport was lost. Is that covered?

pete.peopleops: Express visas needed due to lost/stolen documents are reimbursable if they directly support business travel. Manager sign-off required. Please add a manager approval comment in the expense (email or slack screenshot).

cfo.finance: Also note: if the embassy refund or insurance later covers some costs, we will reconcile. For now we process full reimbursement but mark as "subject to recovery" in the notes.

ana.engineer: I only have a bank statement line and photos of the receipts (embassy printed stub + courier label). Is that ok?

pete.peopleops: Yes. Photos + bank statement are fine. Add a short timeline of events (stolen at 21:00, reported to police, embassy visit next morning). If you filed a police report, attach it.

travelbot: Reminder: set cost_center and project_code and choose approver. Expenses missing approver will be returned.

cfo.finance: Sample note you can paste:
"""
Stolen passport incident 2026-05-10 Lisbon. Reimbursing emergency travel document and courier to return passport:
- Embassy emergency travel document:  (receipt attached)
- Express visa fee:  (approved by @jordan.sales 2026-05-09)
- Courier DHL express:  (tracking attached)
Police report attached. Flagged as Subject-to-Recovery if insurer reimburses.
"""

ana.engineer: Submitted with police report and manager approval. Thank you for the quick help.
